latest_cos_commentary.headline: Custom Channels is an in-store audio and digital-signage platform for restaurants, recently integrating loyalty data (via a Thanx partnership) into targeted audio promotions.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on loyalty_engagement and digital_menu_boards adjacency — specifically in-store audio/messaging as a guest-engagement and promotion channel, rather than core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Active partnership and product cadence through 2026 (Thanx loyalty integration in May, new portal in August, Steady Brand partnership in September) suggests this is a growing category for guest engagement.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant when a prospect discusses in-store guest engagement/promotion channels beyond the POS screen; Custom Channels' Thanx integration is a notable reference point for loyalty-linked in-store marketing.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: The Bubbakoo's Burritos loyalty sign-up increase is a single-customer, partner-reported figure — do not generalize it as a typical or guaranteed outcome.
